title: 键盘键帽拼成的狗狗俯视图

Create a photorealistic 8K top-down flat lay composition of a dog formed entirely from real mechanical keyboard keycaps. The keycaps should be matte PBT plastic in OEM or Cherry profile, arranged in a tight, uniform grid. Every keycap must include crisp, realistic legends—letters, numbers, punctuation, function keys, arrows, and symbols—printed in double-shot or dye-sublimated style. No blank keycaps are allowed. The distribution of legends should feel naturally randomized, as if sourced from real keyboards, with believable variation.

The keycaps must be precisely arranged to form a clean, clearly recognizable side-profile silhouette of a dog. The silhouette should be sharp and well-defined, with smooth contour transitions that accurately capture the dog’s head, ears, body, legs, and tail. Outside the silhouette, there should be pure white negative space with no additional objects or distractions.

The background must be seamless, pure white. The composition should have a 16:9 aspect ratio and be perfectly centered in frame. The camera angle must be an exact 90-degree overhead view with minimal perspective distortion, maintaining a completely flat surface appearance.

Lighting should be soft, diffused studio lighting with very gentle contact shadows beneath each keycap and subtle edge highlights that emphasize the plastic texture. Avoid harsh shadows or dramatic contrast. The overall result should feel ultra-sharp, clean, noise-free, and highly detailed, showcasing realistic material texture and precise arrangement.

正面を向いた動画風のショットを作成。カメラは顔の高さで固定、被写体の真正面に配置。被写体は姿勢と構図から座っていることが示されている。

被写体の表情は穏やかでリラックスしており、自然なほのかな微笑みを浮かべている。まるでカメラに向かってVlogを語り始めようとしているかのようだ。画質は夜間の屋内で撮影された動画（高画質）を反映しており、フィルター、美化効果、人工的なシャープネス処理は一切施されていない。

空間は個人的な空間として感じられる。ボケはカメラの限界によるもので、人工的な被写界深度効果ではない。全体的な雰囲気は温かく、明るく、親密で、被写体が話し始める直前のリアルなVlogの瞬間を思わせる。

女性のセリフは、「今日のファッションは【ファッションの特徴を追加】がポイントです！」と優しい口調で話しながら服を触っている。最後に笑顔になる。

拍摄对象的表情平静放松，带着自然而浅淡的微笑。她看起来像是即将开始对着镜头为 Vlog 讲话。图像质量反映了室内夜间拍摄的高质量视频，绝对没有应用滤镜、美颜效果或人工锐化。

A rugged mining settlement built into a jungle-covered volcanic slope with wooden platforms, drilling towers, and rope lifts. Tiny workers guide carts along narrow tracks while monkeys climb vines and dense foliage surrounds the machinery.

When generating or inventing a scene, prioritize architectural and cultural diversity and intentionally vary the environment type, building styles, historical inspiration, regional influence, and settlement purpose so each generated miniature feels visually distinct and not a repetition of common village, temple, garden, or plaza layouts.

Maintain collectible figurine scale and clean display presentation.

Use soft professional studio product lighting: gentle global illumination, warm key light, soft ambient bounce, controlled shadows, and optional warm interior window glow.
Render any water or translucent materials as poured clear resin with smooth transparency, subtle reflections, soft internal depth, and slightly thick stylized edges.
Include small environmental details but keep everything cohesive, simplified, and sculptural. Prioritize clean stylized modeling over photorealistic texture detail.
Overall intent: premium collectible miniature, stylized 3D marketplace presentation, cozy whimsical mood, smooth sculpt clarity, controlled studio rendering, avoid real-world photography aesthetics.
